unproved_limits: No claim that complex phases outside the Newman sign face cannot improve the odd-order constant.

limitations: The theorem is exact only on the real Newman sign face a+bz-cz^2 with nonnegative magnitudes.
It gives a lower bound, not an exact value, for the unrestricted odd-order finite-cyclic Sidon constant.
Finite numerical replay is corroborative and not the infinite proof.
title: Exact odd-grid Newman-face Sidon bound for three consecutive characters
